author: test-reviewer

findings.description: Test name `processFindFormWithPageBelowOneNormalizesToFirstPage` names the method under call rather than stating a behavior. The brief's BDD school requires `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}`. A name that would not survive renaming `processFindForm` is an implementation name, not a behavior specification. Rename to `theOwnerListShouldShowFirstPageWhenRequestedPageIsBelowOne` or equivalent.

The test only exercises `page=0`. The production fix normalizes all values where `page < 1`, which includes negative integers (`-1`, `-99`, `Integer.MIN_VALUE`). The boundary at zero is tested, but the full range the fix claims to handle is not. A `@ParameterizedTest` with `@CsvSource` covering at least `0`, `-1`, and a large negative value would close this gap and serve as a more complete specification of the normalization rule.

No blank line separates the Arrange phase (`when(...).thenReturn(tasks)`) from the Act phase (`mockMvc.perform(...)`). The brief requires phases separated by blank lines. Add one blank line between the mock-setup line and `mockMvc.perform`.
findings.fix: Insert a blank line between `when(this.owners.findByLastNameStartingWith(anyString(), any(Pageable.class))).thenReturn(tasks);` and `mockMvc.perform(get("/owners?page=0"))`.

findings.description: `new Owner()` is a direct production constructor call. The brief requires production types to be constructed through factory methods in tests written from 2026-07-31 onward. A `createAnOwner()` anonymous factory already implied by the `george()` pattern should wrap the second `Owner` instance.
findings.fix: Replace `new Owner()` with a factory method such as `createAnOwner()` that constructs a minimally-valid Owner with generated irrelevant field values.

approved_aspects: Test genuinely reproduces the reported bug: `page=0` is sent, two owners are returned by the mock (avoiding the single-owner redirect), and the assertion `model().attribute("currentPage", 1)` directly verifies normalization to page 1
MockMvc is used correctly as the sanctioned HTTP-transport double; no internal code is mocked beyond the repository boundary
Assertions use MockMvc's ResultMatcher DSL (status, model, view) rather than bare JUnit asserts
The new test is independent of the existing suite, uses no shared mutable state, and the mock is scoped to the method

author: doc-reviewer

findings.description: Test method name violates the BDD naming convention in docs/testing-principles.md § Test Naming (applies from 2026-07-31 onward). The name 'processFindFormWithPageBelowOneNormalizesToFirstPage' names the production method rather than specifying behavior. A behavior name survives renaming the production method; this one would not.
findings.fix: Rename to 'theOwnerSearchShouldDisplayFirstPageWhenPageIsBelowOne' or an equivalent that reads as a behavioral specification.

findings.description: Variable 'tasks' is a Mystery-tier name per docs/testing-principles.md § Three-Tier Data Naming. 'tasks' is not a domain term in this veterinary clinic system and carries no role description. A Page<Owner> result that drives which page is rendered is meaningful data; a mystery name makes it invisible as such.
findings.fix: Rename to 'owners' (role-describing, Tier 1) or to 'ANY_OWNERS' if it is truly irrelevant scaffolding. 'tasks' should be eliminated.

The normalization is placed at the correct entry point — before any downstream pagination logic executes — so the fix is correctly scoped
The controller comment accurately describes the intent of the guard at the right level of abstraction

The other two entries ("0" and "-1") are self-explaining in this context and need no comment.
findings.fix: Expand @CsvSource to multi-line form and add a trailing comment: "-2147483648" // Integer.MIN_VALUE
